Automatic, transparent -- keyed by FILE, not by query.

First read of a remote Parquet/Delta file -> local SSD copy
Every later read of the SAME file, on the SAME cluster,
by ANY query -> served from local disk instead
caption: No code changes anything -- this runs underneath every query.

df = spark.table("gold.daily_revenue").filter("region = 'west'")
df.cache()      # materializes df's RESULT in cluster memory
df.count()      # triggers it (Spark is lazy)
# ... reuse df cheaply, several times ...
df.unpersist()  # you release it -- nobody does this for you
caption: Explicit, keyed by DataFrame -- lasts for the life of the session.
